dashboard.label: TA-throttle Overview
dashboard.description: Collects CPU frequency state from /sys/devices/system/cpu (per-core current/min/max frequency, governor) and hardware thermal-throttle counters (package_throttle_count,

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" app="TA-throttle" [| rest /services/server/info | eval host=splunk_server | fields host] earliest=-3h | stats latest(status) as st | eval value=if(st=="active","Licensed","Unlicensed") | table value

single.option: key beacon within 3h - enter a key on the License page

panel.html: This host is licensed for TA-throttle. Thanks for supporting BentleyPC development!

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-throttle requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-throttle", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-throttle/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click "Open License Setup page" to paste your key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M"), setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" | append [ | makeresults | eval host="this deployment", status="no data yet", note="beacon reports hourly once a key is set", last_reported="n/a", setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" ] | table host status last_reported note setup | sort host
| mstats avg("throttle.cpu_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("throttle.pkg_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("throttle.freq_avg_mhz") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1

panel.title: Fixed governors in use (fleet, latest; 1=only one governor)

search.query: | mstats avg("throttle.governor_fixed") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1

panel.title: Per-package throttle counters - latest per host

search.query: index=main sourcetype="throttle:status" | dedup host | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | where match(o,"\"throttle_count\"") | spath input=o path=throttle_count | spath input=o path=new | table host k throttle_count new
